title: ‘Returning brains’: Tax incentives, migration, and scientific productivity
title_zh: 回流人才”：税收激励、移民与科学产出
title_primary: 回流人才”：税收激励、移民与科学产出
title_secondary: ‘Returning brains’: Tax incentives, migration, and scientific productivity
authors: Pier Paolo Creanza
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates how tax incentives for high-skill immigrants affect productivity. I collect data covering 90 percent of Italian faculty between 2000 and 2020 and use it to evaluate a 2004 tax break offering a temporary 90 percent reduction in taxable income for researchers. First, the evidence is consistent with the program attracting substantial return migration and positive selection of beneficiaries. Second, among groups that make an eligible hire, I find evidence consistent with higher-productivity hires significantly increasing their academic group’s average productivity, roughly split between their direct contribution and indirect responses of local faculty. Third, this indirect effect is largely explained by higher-productivity local researchers sorting into the treated group, rather than by productivity spillovers on incumbent researchers. An instrumental variable strategy based on perfect assortative matching corroborates the main findings.
abstract_zh: 本文研究高技能移民的税收激励如何影响生产率。我收集了涵盖2000年至2020年间意大利90%高校教师的数据，并以此评估2004年一项为研究人员提供应税收入暂时减免90%的税收优惠政策。首先，证据与该政策吸引了大量回流移民以及受益人中存在正向选择相一致。其次，在进行了符合条件招聘的群体中，我发现与更高生产率的受聘者显著提高其学术群体平均生产率相一致的证据，这一效应大致可分解为受聘者的直接贡献与本地教师的间接反应两部分。第三，这种间接效应在很大程度上可由更高生产率的本地研究人员分类进入处理组来解释，而非由对在职研究人员的生产率溢出效应所解释。基于完全同配匹配的工具变量策略印证了主要发现。

title: From two heads to one: Electoral and governance consequences of political recentralization
title_zh: 从双头到一元：政治再集权的选举与治理后果
title_primary: 从双头到一元：政治再集权的选举与治理后果
title_secondary: From two heads to one: Electoral and governance consequences of political recentralization
authors: Olivier Marie, Thomas Post, Zihan Ye, Xiaopeng Zou
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The consequences of retracting democratic rights in authoritarian regimes remain understudied. In 2018, China’s Communist Party implemented the ‘one-head’ policy, replacing dual village governance with a single leader. Using nationally representative survey data and exploiting the exogeneity of village election cycles as an instrument, we analyze short-term effects on voting behavior and political perceptions. Villages adopting the one-head system experienced a sizable decline in election turnout. At the same time, villagers reported lower perceived corruption and greater confidence in local governance. In addition, we find supporting evidence based on changes in objective economic indicators. These results suggest that recentralization reduced electoral participation but did not erode, and may have improved, (perceived) governance quality in the short run.
abstract_zh: 威权体制下撤回民主权利的后果仍未得到充分研究。2018年，中国共产党实施了“一肩挑”政策，以单一领导取代了村级双重治理。利用全国代表性调查数据，并借助村级选举周期的外生性作为工具变量，我们分析了该政策对投票行为和政治认知的短期影响。实行“一肩挑”制度的村庄，选举投票率显著下降。与此同时，村民报告的腐败感知降低，对地方治理的信心增强。此外，我们基于客观经济指标的变化找到了支持性证据。这些结果表明，权力再集中减少了选举参与，但在短期内并未削弱，甚至可能提升了（感知的）治理质量。

title: Where the Grass Seems Greener: Economic Misperceptions and Support for Democracy
title_zh: 草更绿之处：经济误解与民主支持
title_primary: 草更绿之处：经济误解与民主支持
title_secondary: Where the Grass Seems Greener: Economic Misperceptions and Support for Democracy
authors: Daron Acemoglu, Nicolas Ajzenman, Guillermo Cruces, Martin Fiszbein, Gaston Garcia Zavaleta 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Support for populist and authoritarian regimes is rising worldwide, despite evidence that they tend to underperform economically. We examine the role of (mis)perceptions of regime performance as drivers of political attitudes, leveraging two survey experiments with 11,377 respondents during Argentina’s 2023 presidential elections. Optimistic beliefs about the performance of populist and non-democratic regimes were widespread, and displayed a strong correlation with support for these regimes. When exposed to randomly assigned informational treatments challenging optimistic views about these political regimes, individuals significantly adjusted their beliefs, and reduced their support for candidates they associate with populist and authoritarian leanings. Exploring the impact of different information sources, we find that academic sources and newspapers were more influential than social media. Although individuals adjusted their beliefs and attitudes in response to information on regime performance, contradicting their prior beliefs reduced their demand for additional information, consistent with an important role for motivated reasoning.
abstract_zh: 尽管有证据表明民粹主义和威权政权往往在经济上表现不佳，但全球范围内对其支持率仍在上升。我们通过阿根廷2023年总统选举期间对11,377名受访者进行的两项调查实验，考察了（错误）认知对政权表现作为政治态度驱动因素的作用。关于民粹主义和非民主政权表现的乐观信念普遍存在，并与对这些政权的支持显示出强烈相关性。当接触到随机分配的信息干预，挑战对这些政治政权表现的乐观看法时，个体显著调整了其信念，并减少了对他们与民粹主义和威权倾向相关联的候选人的支持。通过探索不同信息来源的影响，我们发现学术来源和报纸比社交媒体更具影响力。尽管个体根据政权表现的信息调整了其信念和态度，但与其先前信念相矛盾的信息减少了他们对额外信息的需求，这与动机性推理的重要作用相一致。

title: On the Political Economy of Nonlinear Income Taxation
title_zh: 论非线性所得税的政治经济学
title_primary: 论非线性所得税的政治经济学
title_secondary: On the Political Economy of Nonlinear Income Taxation
authors: Marcus Berliant, Miguel Gouveia
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The political economy setting of voting over general nonlinear income taxes with labor disincentives and information asymmetry in consumer/worker/voter types is considered. Agents do not communicate or coordinate with each other. The economy is the realization of a finite draw from a continuous distribution. The revenue required from a draw is determined by Pareto optimal provision of a public good for that draw. Assuming that the government must meet the revenue requirement for any possible draw, in other words the tax is robust, a majority rule equilibrium is shown to exist at the median voter’s preferred tax function out of this robust set. The key restrictions on utility are additive separability, quasi-linearity, and that utility from the public good is multiplicative in type. JEL numbers: D72, D82, H21, H41 Keywords: Voting; Income taxation; Public good; Robustness
abstract_zh: 本文考虑了在一般非线性所得税上进行投票的政治经济环境，其中包含劳动抑制因素以及消费者/工人/选民类型的信息不对称。各主体之间不进行沟通或协调。经济状态是连续分布中有限次抽取的实现结果。每次抽取所需的财政收入由该抽取下公共物品的帕累托最优供给决定。假设政府必须满足任何可能抽取下的财政收入要求，即税收具有稳健性，则证明在多数规则均衡下，存在中位选民在该稳健集合中最偏好的税收函数。对效用的关键限制包括可加可分性、拟线性，以及公共物品效用与类型呈乘性关系。JEL分类号：D72, D82, H21, H41 关键词：投票；所得税；公共物品；稳健性

title: DP10999 Exact Present Solution with Consistent Future Approximation: A Gridless Algorithm to Solve Stochastic Dynamic Models
title_zh: 精确现值解与一致未来近似：求解随机动态模型的无网格算法
title_primary: 精确现值解与一致未来近似：求解随机动态模型的无网格算法
title_secondary: DP10999 Exact Present Solution with Consistent Future Approximation: A Gridless Algorithm to Solve Stochastic Dynamic Models
authors: Wouter Den Haan, Michal Kobielarz, Pontus Rendahl
official: 官方在线 2015-12-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper proposes an algorithm that finds model solutions at a particular point in the state space by solving a simple system of equations. The key step is to characterize future behavior with a Taylor series expansion of the current period's behavior around the contemporaneous values for the state variables. Since current decisions are solved from the original model equations, the solution incorporates nonlinearities and uncertainty. The algorithm is used to solve the model considered in Coeurdacier, Rey, and Winant (2011), which is a challenging model because it has no steady state and uncertainty is necessary to keep the model well behaved. We show that our algorithm can generate accurate solutions even when the model series are quite volatile. The solutions generated by the risky-steady-state algorithm proposed in Coeurdacier, Rey, and Winant (2011), in contrast, is shown to be not accurate.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种算法，该算法通过求解一个简单的方程组，在状态空间的特定点上找到模型解。关键步骤在于，利用当前时期行为关于状态变量当期值的泰勒级数展开，来刻画未来行为。由于当前决策是从原始模型方程中求解得出的，因此解包含了非线性和不确定性。该算法被用于求解Coeurdacier、Rey和Winant（2011）所考虑的模型，这是一个具有挑战性的模型，因为它没有稳态，且不确定性对于保持模型的良好行为是必要的。我们证明，即使模型序列波动相当剧烈，我们的算法也能生成精确的解。相比之下，Coeurdacier、Rey和Winant（2011）提出的风险稳态算法所生成的解则被证明是不精确的。

title: When Public Signals Backfire: Strategic Disclosure and Information Crowd-Out
title_zh: 当公共信号适得其反：策略性披露与信息挤出效应
title_primary: 当公共信号适得其反：策略性披露与信息挤出效应
title_secondary: When Public Signals Backfire: Strategic Disclosure and Information Crowd-Out
authors: Marty Haoyuan Chen, Ginger Zhe Jin
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study voluntary disclosure when partially naive receivers observe a public signal correlated with the sender’s private information. We develop a framework in which the public signal changes how receivers interpret silence, and derive a closed-form disclosure threshold nesting classical unraveling. A laboratory experiment varying the correlation confirms our predictions: disclosure decreases as the signal becomes more favorable, and receiver guesses upon nondisclosure rise toward it. The public signal can crowd out disclosure, leaving receivers less informed than without it. This informational loss peaks at intermediate correlation, where the signal shifts beliefs yet remains too noisy to substitute for disclosure.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当部分天真的接收者观察到与发送者私人信息相关的公开信号时的自愿披露行为。我们构建了一个框架，其中公开信号改变了接收者对沉默的解读方式，并推导出一个嵌套经典“拆解”结果的闭式披露阈值。一项改变相关性的实验室实验证实了我们的预测：随着信号变得更为有利，披露减少，而接收者在未披露情况下的猜测则向该信号靠拢。公开信号可能挤出披露，使接收者比没有该信号时信息更少。这种信息损失在中等相关性时达到峰值，此时信号虽能改变信念，但仍过于嘈杂，无法替代披露。

title: Exchange Rates, Structural Change, and Productivity Growth
title_zh: 汇率、结构变迁与生产率增长
title_primary: 汇率、结构变迁与生产率增长
title_secondary: Exchange Rates, Structural Change, and Productivity Growth
authors: Paul Bergin, Woo Jin Choi, Ju H. Pyun
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Macroeconomics tends to view exchange rate movements as transitory. However, persistent exchange rate realignments and the associated capital flows can have long-run implications for structural change and productivity growth. We provide empirical evidence that policies of reserve accumulation and currency undervaluation have had significant effects on manufacturing productivity, as well as on manufacturing share, product varieties, and domestic orientation of production chains. We develop a dynamic two-country model with two sectors, firm dynamics, and trade hysteresis to demonstrate a novel mechanism by which exchange rate policy reorients global supply chains and industrial structure. The model identifies conditions under which such a policy raises productivity and welfare in the home country. It also identifies conditions under which the policy leads to either permanent or reversible deindustrialization in a trading partner. Findings have implications for the long-run relationship between China and the U.S.
abstract_zh: 宏观经济学通常将汇率变动视为暂时性现象。然而，持续的汇率重估及其伴随的资本流动可能对结构变革和生产率增长产生长期影响。我们提供的经验证据表明，储备积累和货币低估政策对制造业生产率、制造业份额、产品种类及生产链的国内导向均产生了显著效应。我们构建了一个包含两个部门、企业动态和贸易滞后性的动态两国模型，以展示汇率政策如何重新引导全球供应链和产业结构的新机制。该模型识别了此类政策提升本国生产率和福利的条件，同时也明确了政策导致贸易伙伴国出现永久性或可逆性去工业化的条件。研究结果对中美之间的长期关系具有启示意义。

title: Ozone pollution, cash crop production, and farmer adaptation: evidence from China
title_zh: 臭氧污染、经济作物生产与农户适应：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 臭氧污染、经济作物生产与农户适应：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Ozone pollution, cash crop production, and farmer adaptation: evidence from China
authors: Wanyu Ran, Xiaoguang Chen, Xiaoli Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Surface ozone pollution has emerged as a major threat to agricultural productivity, yet evidence on its impacts on high-value cash crops and farmers’ adaptive responses remains limited. Combining a household-level panel from the Chinese National Fixed-Point Survey with high-resolution pollution and weather data from 2003 to 2013, we find that rising ozone concentrations significantly reduced farm income of fruit growers, primarily driven by ozone-induced reductions in fruit yields, total production, and labor productivity. Sugar crops also experienced significant yield losses, while other cash crops exhibited negligible responses. Due to limited adaptive capacity, fruit growers responded by abandoning ozone-damaged plots, reducing input use, and reallocating labor towards off-farm employment, resulting in persistent income losses with little evidence of longer-run adjustment. In contrast, sugar producers offset yield losses by expanding cultivated area and increasing material inputs, maintaining output and income. These findings highlight the critical importance of ozone-control policies and targeted support to strengthen farmers’ adaptive capacity, particularly for fruit growers who are most vulnerable to rising ozone exposure.
abstract_zh: 地表臭氧污染已成为农业生产力的重大威胁，然而其对高价值经济作物及农户适应性应对措施的影响证据仍然有限。结合中国农村固定观察点的农户层面面板数据与2003年至2013年间的高分辨率污染和气象数据，我们发现臭氧浓度上升显著降低了果农的农业收入，主要归因于臭氧引起的果实产量、总产量及劳动生产率下降。糖料作物同样遭受显著产量损失，而其他经济作物的反应则微乎其微。由于适应能力有限，果农通过弃耕受臭氧损害的农田、减少投入品使用以及将劳动力转向非农就业来应对，导致收入持续损失，且几乎没有长期调整的迹象。相比之下，糖料生产者通过扩大种植面积和增加物质投入来弥补产量损失，从而维持了产出和收入。这些发现凸显了臭氧控制政策及针对性支持以增强农户适应能力的关键重要性，尤其是对于最易受臭氧暴露上升影响的果农而言。

title: Non‐Regular Distributions, Virtual Values and Monopoly Problems
title_zh: 非正则分布、虚拟价值与垄断问题
title_primary: 非正则分布、虚拟价值与垄断问题
title_secondary: Non‐Regular Distributions, Virtual Values and Monopoly Problems
authors: Paolo Morganti
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We revisit the standard regularity assumption used to ensure uniqueness of the optimal price in monopoly models, namely that the Virtual Value (VV) function is monotone. This condition is typically imposed through strong distributional assumptions, such as log‐concavity, that restrict the model's flexibility and implicitly discipline the sign of comparative statics. We show that these assumptions can be relaxed without compromising tractability or uniqueness. Our main contribution is to introduce ‐Regularity, a weaker condition that requires monotonicity of the VV only beyond the threshold where marginal revenue becomes nonnegative. We demonstrate that many common non‐regular, unimodal distributions satisfy this local condition. This shift in focus allows standard first‐order methods to remain valid, and it enlarges the set of tractable demand primitives in applied IO. As an implication, when hazard rates are not monotone over the relevant pricing range, comparative statics need not follow the direction imposed by log‐concavity. The framework also reduces the need for ironing when modeling with heavy‐tailed demand.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了垄断模型中用于确保最优价格唯一性的标准正则性假设，即虚拟价值函数单调的条件。这一条件通常通过强分布假设（如对数凹性）来施加，但这些假设限制了模型的灵活性，并隐含地约束了比较静态的方向。我们证明，这些假设可以在不牺牲可处理性或唯一性的前提下被放宽。本文的主要贡献在于引入“局部正则性”这一更弱的条件，该条件仅要求虚拟价值函数在边际收入变为非负的阈值之后保持单调。我们证明，许多常见的非正则单峰分布满足这一局部条件。这一视角的转变使得标准的一阶方法仍然有效，并扩大了应用产业组织中可处理的需求基元集合。其含义在于，当风险率在相关定价范围内不单调时，比较静态的方向不必遵循对数凹性所施加的路径。该框架还减少了在建模重尾需求时进行“熨平”处理的必要性。

title: Money and gender: Proxy respondents and the mismeasurement of income in surveys
title_zh: 金钱与性别：调查中代理受访者与收入的测量偏差
title_primary: 金钱与性别：调查中代理受访者与收入的测量偏差
title_secondary: Money and gender: Proxy respondents and the mismeasurement of income in surveys
authors: Ricardo Estrada, Daniela Goyheix, María Lombardi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: When sampled individuals are not found at home, many surveys rely on a proxy respondent: another knowledgeable household member. We study the effect of proxy reporting on the measurement of labor income in Mexico. For identification, we use the panel structure of the Mexican labor force survey and compare workers’ reported earnings when they report them themselves to their reported earnings when another household member does the reporting. We find that male workers’ monthly earnings are 7.2% lower when reported by a proxy, whereas female workers’ earnings are only 1.8% lower. We provide evidence that this gender gap reflects both compositional effects, linked to men’s higher earnings, and household informational asymmetries, partly driven by men’s greater propensity to hide income from other household members. Finally, we study the implications of using proxy respondents and find that it can lead to an underestimation of the gender wage gap by 25%.
abstract_zh: 当抽样个体不在家时，许多调查依赖代理受访者：即另一位了解情况的家庭成员。我们研究了代理报告对墨西哥劳动收入测量的影响。为识别因果效应，我们利用墨西哥劳动力调查的面板结构，比较工人在自我报告收入与由其他家庭成员代理报告时的收入差异。我们发现，男性工人的月收入在代理报告时低7.2%，而女性工人的收入仅低1.8%。我们提供的证据表明，这一性别差异既反映了与男性较高收入相关的构成效应，也反映了家庭信息不对称，部分原因在于男性更倾向于向其他家庭成员隐瞒收入。最后，我们研究了使用代理受访者的影响，发现这可能导致性别工资差距被低估25%。

title: Low Participation and Risk Reduction Potential of Supplemental Crop Insurance in the United States
title_zh: 美国补充性农作物保险的低参与率与风险降低潜力
title_primary: 美国补充性农作物保险的低参与率与风险降低潜力
title_secondary: Low Participation and Risk Reduction Potential of Supplemental Crop Insurance in the United States
authors: Francis Tsiboe, Hunter Biram, Amy Hagerman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Federally subsidized crop insurance is a cornerstone of U.S. farm risk management, yet policies with the greatest share of participation only trigger indemnities after losses exceed 15%. Supplemental insurance was introduced to cover part of this deductible, but participation remains largely unchanged. Using 1,005,245 sub‐county aggregated insurance observations and applying novel calibration and simulation methods, we show that low participation in supplemental coverage limits risk reduction potential. While basic insurance provides a foundation, adding supplemental policies meaningfully improves downside risk reduction and income transfer. Although these gains involve higher premiums, a benefit‐per‐premium analysis still favors broader use. These results reflect potential program impacts conditional on adoption, recognizing that actual participation depends on farmer preferences, risk perceptions, and institutional constraints.
abstract_zh: 联邦补贴作物保险是美国农业风险管理的基石，但参与率最高的保单仅在损失超过15%后才触发赔付。补充保险旨在覆盖部分免赔额，但参与率基本未变。利用1,005,245个次县级汇总保险观测数据，并应用新型校准与模拟方法，我们发现补充保险的低参与率限制了风险降低潜力。虽然基础保险提供了保障基础，但增加补充保单能显著改善下行风险降低和收入转移效果。尽管这些收益伴随更高保费，但每单位保费收益分析仍支持更广泛使用。这些结果反映了在采用条件下的潜在项目影响，同时认识到实际参与取决于农户偏好、风险感知和制度约束。

title: Birth timing, stable population growth, and pay-as-you-go pensions
title_zh: 生育时机、稳定人口增长与现收现付养老金
title_primary: 生育时机、稳定人口增长与现收现付养老金
title_secondary: Birth timing, stable population growth, and pay-as-you-go pensions
authors: Jinghong Gu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This note studies a pure fertility-timing reform in a three-period OLG model. Holding completed fertility fixed, shifting births from middle age to youth raises the balanced-growth factor if N > 1 , lowers it if N < 1 , and leaves it unchanged if N = 1 . The same positive balanced-growth root λ determines cohort growth, the cohort ratio, and the steady-state PAYG support ratio λ 2 + λ . Thus the long-run support-ratio effect, and under an exogenous wage the pension-benefit effect, are positive in growing populations and negative in shrinking ones.
abstract_zh: 本文在三期OLG模型中研究了一项纯粹的生育时机改革。在保持终身生育率不变的前提下，将生育行为从中年阶段提前至青年阶段，若N>1则会提高平衡增长因子，若N<1则会降低该因子，若N=1则保持不变。相同的正平衡增长根λ决定了队列增长、队列比率以及稳态现收现付制抚养比λ²+λ。因此，长期抚养比效应以及在外生工资条件下的养老金待遇效应，在人口增长型社会中为正，在人口收缩型社会中为负。

title: Misperceived Social Norms and Willingness to Act Against Climate Change
title_zh: 误解的社会规范与应对气候变化的意愿
title_primary: 误解的社会规范与应对气候变化的意愿
title_secondary: Misperceived Social Norms and Willingness to Act Against Climate Change
authors: Peter Andre, Teodora Boneva, Felix Chopra, Armin Falk
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document the individual willingness to act against climate change and study the role of social norms in a large sample of U.S. adults. Individual beliefs about social norms positively predict pro-climate donations, comparable in strength to universal moral values and economic preferences. However, we document systematic misperceptions of social norms. Respondents vastly underestimate the prevalence of climate-friendly behaviors and norms. Correcting these misperceptions in an experiment causally raises individual willingness to act against climate change and individual support for climate policies. The effects are strongest for individuals who are skeptical about the existence and threat of global warming.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了个体应对气候变化的意愿，并在美国成年人大型样本中研究了社会规范的作用。个体对社会规范的信念正向预测亲气候捐赠行为，其预测强度与普遍道德价值观和经济偏好相当。然而，我们发现了对社会规范的系统性认知偏差。受访者严重低估了气候友好行为及规范的普遍性。通过实验纠正这些认知偏差，能因果性地提升个体应对气候变化的意愿及对气候政策的支持。该效应在质疑全球变暖存在及其威胁的个体中最为显著。

title: Private Equity Ownership and Firm Performance: A Framework for Interpreting the Evidence
title_zh: 私募股权所有权与企业绩效：证据解释框架
title_primary: 私募股权所有权与企业绩效：证据解释框架
title_secondary: Private Equity Ownership and Firm Performance: A Framework for Interpreting the Evidence
authors: Per Strömberg, Christian Thomann
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We review the evidence on the impact of private equity (PE) ownership on firms, stakeholders, and the economy. We organize this literature using a framework that emphasizes the costs and benefits of PE as an ownership form and implies five main predictions: (i) only some firms are natural PE targets; (ii) PE ownership is optimally temporary; (iii) debt is typically a cheaper source of capital than PE equity; (iv) PE activity is strongly cyclical; and (v) the PE model is a second-best response to underlying agency and contracting frictions. We use this framework to interpret existing evidence and to clarify when, and for whom, PE ownership creates value.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了私募股权（PE）所有权对企业、利益相关者及经济影响的实证证据。我们通过一个强调PE作为所有权形式的成本与收益的分析框架来组织相关文献，该框架隐含五个主要预测：（i）仅部分企业是天然的PE收购目标；（ii）PE所有权具有最优的暂时性特征；（iii）债务通常比PE股权更具成本优势；（iv）PE活动呈现强周期性；（v）PE模式是对潜在代理问题与契约摩擦的次优应对方案。我们运用该框架解释现有证据，并阐明PE所有权在何种情境下、为哪些主体创造价值。

title: Inflation and Unemployment in the Long Run Revisited
title_zh: 长期视角下通货膨胀与失业关系的再探讨
title_primary: 长期视角下通货膨胀与失业关系的再探讨
title_secondary: Inflation and Unemployment in the Long Run Revisited
authors: Zachary Bethune, Michael Choi, Sébastien Lotz, Guillaume Rocheteau
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We construct a continuous-time, monetary model with frictional goods and labour markets to revisit the long-run relationship between inflation and unemployment. By endogenising the value of consumers’ outside options and market power in accordance with standard consumer search theory, we generate novel predictions for the slope of the long-run Phillips curve, optimal monetary policy, and outcomes at the frictionless limit. The relationship between inflation and unemployment is non-monotone and, at low inflation rates, an increase in inflation reduces unemployment. The Friedman rule is suboptimal when firms’ average bargaining power across markets is low. Markups and markdowns vanish as frictions disappear.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们构建了一个包含摩擦性商品与劳动力市场的连续时间货币模型，以重新审视通胀与失业之间的长期关系。通过依据标准消费者搜寻理论内生化消费者外部选择价值与市场势力，我们为长期菲利普斯曲线的斜率、最优货币政策以及无摩擦极限下的结果提出了新的预测。通胀与失业之间的关系是非单调的，且在低通胀率下，通胀上升会降低失业率。当企业在各市场的平均议价能力较低时，弗里德曼规则并非最优。随着摩擦的消失，加成率与折价率也将消失。

title: Environmental Liability, Insurance, and Market Structure in Coal Mining
title_zh: 煤矿开采中的环境责任、保险与市场结构
title_primary: 煤矿开采中的环境责任、保险与市场结构
title_secondary: Environmental Liability, Insurance, and Market Structure in Coal Mining
authors: Tom Eisenberg, Joshua Macey
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines a Pennsylvania policy reform that increased bonded liability for coal mines with reclamation obligations. A 2001 change for surface mines was largely priced into existing reclamation insurance mechanisms, which exist to prevent mines from shirking their liabilities. We find that the changes increased mine-level insured liability and idling (≈15% for median mines), led to declines in production, and did not change environmental performance directly for treated mines. However, we do find that these effects were driven largely by higher polluting mines. Major results are robust to both comparing bituminous and anthracite mines within Pennsylvania as well as bituminous mines between Pennsylvania and Virginia.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了宾夕法尼亚州一项政策改革，该改革提高了负有复垦义务的煤矿的有担保负债。2001年针对露天矿的一项变更，在很大程度上已被纳入现有的复垦保险机制中，该机制旨在防止煤矿逃避其责任。我们发现，这些变化增加了矿井层面的保险负债和闲置率（中位数矿井约15%），导致产量下降，且未直接改变受处理矿井的环境绩效。然而，我们确实发现这些效应主要由污染较高的矿井驱动。主要结果在比较宾夕法尼亚州内部的烟煤和无烟煤矿井，以及宾夕法尼亚州与弗吉尼亚州之间的烟煤矿井时均保持稳健。

title: Skills That Pay: Digital Skills Demand and Wage Premia in Asia and the Pacific
title_zh: 技能即报酬：亚太地区的数字技能需求与工资溢价
title_primary: 技能即报酬：亚太地区的数字技能需求与工资溢价
title_secondary: Skills That Pay: Digital Skills Demand and Wage Premia in Asia and the Pacific
authors: Pawel Adrjan, Yusuke Aoki, Gabriele Ciminelli, Robin Döttling, Sílvia Garcia-Mandicó
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the evolution of digital and artificial intelligence (AI) skill demand across six economies in Asia and the Pacific between 2019 and 2024 using millions of online job postings from Indeed and a large language model to classify them by their required level of digital and AI proficiency. Digital skill requirements are widespread across the occupational distribution and have expanded most rapidly in traditionally low and mid digital jobs, pointing to broad technological diffusion. Jobs requiring higher digital proficiency command substantially higher pay, even when comparing job postings within the same job title and controlling for cognitive, interpersonal, organizational, and technical skill requirements. We estimate wage premia of approximately 4%, 11%, and 26% for basic, intermediate, and advanced digital skills, respectively, with intermediate and advanced digital skills commanding larger premia than many other highly rewarded skills. We also document a sharp increase in demand for AI-related competencies, particularly those related to the use of AI tools.
abstract_zh: 我们利用Indeed平台数百万条在线招聘信息，结合大语言模型按所需数字与人工智能（AI）技能水平进行分类，研究了2019至2024年间亚太地区六个经济体中数字与AI技能需求的演变。数字技能要求广泛分布于各职业层级，且在传统低数字与中数字岗位中增长最为迅速，这表明技术正在广泛扩散。要求更高数字技能水平的岗位薪资显著更高——即便在相同职位名称内进行比较，并控制认知、人际、组织及技术技能要求后，这一结论依然成立。我们估算出基础、中级与高级数字技能的工资溢价分别约为4%、11%和26%，其中中级与高级数字技能的溢价高于许多其他高回报技能。同时，我们还发现对AI相关能力的需求急剧上升，尤其是涉及AI工具使用的能力。

title: Elderly Health and Longevity in the US: Evidence and Implications
title_zh: 美国老年人健康与长寿：证据与启示
title_primary: 美国老年人健康与长寿：证据与启示
title_secondary: Elderly Health and Longevity in the US: Evidence and Implications
authors: Liran Einav, Amy Finkelstein
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Rising elderly life expectancy is a well-known source of fiscal pressure on Social Security and Medicare – but how have declining mortality and morbidity affected the two programs’ relative finances? Using nearly three decades of Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data (1992-2019), we estimate that these demographic changes raised expected lifetime Social Security spending by over twice as much as expected lifetime Medicare spending: 14% compared to 6%. The slower growth of elderly lifetime health care spending than annuity spending reflects two features of how longevity has increased: the additional 2.4 years of remaining life expectancy were entirely healthy – free of physical or cognitive limitations – while the expected amount of time spent with severe health limitations fell by about 30%, reducing expected lifetime nursing-home and home-health use. We then write down a stylized life-cycle model of a risk-averse retiree facing stochastic mortality and health to illuminate the key forces that affect the optimal allocation of a fixed amount of public funds across Medicare and Social Security.
abstract_zh: 老年人预期寿命延长是社会保障和医疗保险财政压力的众所周知来源——但死亡率和发病率的下降如何影响这两项计划的相对财务状况？利用近三十年的医疗保险当前受益人调查数据（1992-2019年），我们估算出这些人口结构变化使预期终身社会保障支出增加了14%，而预期终身医疗保险支出仅增加了6%，前者增幅是后者的两倍以上。老年人终身医疗支出增长慢于年金支出增长，这反映了寿命延长的两个特征：新增的2.4年剩余预期寿命完全处于健康状态——无身体或认知障碍——而严重健康受限的预期时间减少了约30%，从而降低了预期终身护理院和居家护理的使用。随后，我们构建了一个面临随机死亡率和健康状况的风险厌恶退休者的简化生命周期模型，以阐明影响医疗保险与社会保障之间固定公共资金最优配置的关键因素。

abstract: How does uncertainty about future government policy affect households beliefs and subsequent borrowing, spending and debt payment behavior? We study these questions through the lens of student loan forgiveness in the United States, which following electoral promises, was announced in 2022 but never
abstract_zh: 未来政府政策的不确定性如何影响家庭信念及其后续的借贷、支出和债务偿还行为？我们通过美国学生贷款减免这一案例来研究这些问题。该政策在选举承诺后于2022年宣布，但最终未能实施。

title: Learning to Navigate a New Financial Technology
title_zh: 学习驾驭新型金融技术
title_primary: 学习驾驭新型金融技术
title_secondary: Learning to Navigate a New Financial Technology
authors: EMILY BREZA, MARTIN KANZ, LEORA KLAPPER
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present results from a field experiment that introduced digital payroll accounts to unbanked factory workers to examine how inexperienced consumers learn to use a new financial technology. We find that exposure to payroll accounts leads to increased account use, accelerated learning, and avoidance of common consumer protection risks. Those receiving electronic wage payments gradually build trust in the technology, learn to use accounts without assistance, and avoid illicit fees. Using experimental variation in assignment to bank versus mobile money accounts, we show that these impacts are concentrated in mobile money accounts, the newer, more complex, and less trusted financial technology.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项实地实验，向无银行账户的工厂工人引入数字工资账户，以考察缺乏经验的消费者如何学习使用新型金融技术。研究发现，接触工资账户能提升账户使用率、加速学习进程，并帮助规避常见的消费者保护风险。接受电子工资支付的工人逐渐建立起对该技术的信任，学会独立使用账户，并避免支付非法费用。通过实验性分配银行账户与移动货币账户的差异，我们证明这些影响主要集中在移动货币账户上——这是一种更新颖、更复杂且信任度较低的金融技术。

title: Does having daughters affect political preferences? Using meta-analytic tools on many surveys
title_zh: 拥有女儿会影响政治偏好吗？基于多项调查的元分析工具研究
title_primary: 拥有女儿会影响政治偏好吗？基于多项调查的元分析工具研究
title_secondary: Does having daughters affect political preferences? Using meta-analytic tools on many surveys
authors: Yifan Yang, Magnus Johannesson, Anna Dreber, Frank Fossen, Levent Neyse 等
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This study investigates whether having daughters impacts political preferences and whether this effect varies across European countries. We estimate effect sizes for 39 countries in the European Social Survey ( n = 156,236) and aggregate estimates using random-effects meta-analysis, following a preregistered analysis plan. We find significant evidence that having daughters increases the preference for gender equality and homosexual rights. However, the meta-analytic effect size estimates are small, with 2.6% (95% CI [1.0%, 4.3%]) and 1.9% (95% CI [0.8%, 3.0%]) of a standard deviation, respectively. The meta-analytic effects of having daughters on left-right political preferences and preferences for reduced income inequality are statistically indistinguishable from zero. The heterogeneity in the effects of having daughters across countries is low, with zero to small heterogeneity for three outcome measures and small to moderate heterogeneity for left-right political preferences, consistent with high generalizability of results across the included countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了拥有女儿是否会影响政治偏好，以及这种影响在欧洲各国间是否存在差异。我们依据预先注册的分析计划，对欧洲社会调查中39个国家（样本量n=156,236）的效应量进行了估计，并采用随机效应元分析方法汇总估计结果。研究发现，拥有女儿显著增强了对性别平等和同性恋权利的支持偏好。然而，元分析效应量估计值较小，分别相当于标准差的2.6%（95%置信区间[1.0%, 4.3%]）和1.9%（95%置信区间[0.8%, 3.0%]）。拥有女儿对左右政治偏好及减少收入不平等偏好的元分析效应在统计上与零无显著差异。各国间拥有女儿效应的异质性较低，其中三项结果指标的异质性为零至小，而左右政治偏好的异质性为小至中等，这与结果在所纳入国家间具有高度普遍性相一致。

title: Female board secretaries and stock price informativeness: evidence from China
title_zh: 女性董事会秘书与股价信息含量：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 女性董事会秘书与股价信息含量：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Female board secretaries and stock price informativeness: evidence from China
authors: Jianrong Wang, Bo Wang, Wokun Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates whether the gender of the board secretary, the legally mandated disclosure officer in Chinese listed firms, affects stock price informativeness (SPI). Drawing on Upper Echelons Theory, we posit that female board secretaries serve as superior information translators whose distinct communication styles and risk preferences reduce transmission friction between firms and capital markets. Using a comprehensive sample of Chinese A-share firms from 2010 to 2022, we find that firms with female board secretaries exhibit significantly higher SPI. To establish causality, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences design that accounts for heterogeneous treatment timing across firms. The dynamic treatment effects confirm clean pre-treatment trends and a significant positive impact peaking in the first year following male-to-female transitions. A reverse female-to-male transition yields no significant effect, supporting a causal interpretation. We document two channels: female secretaries enhance the quality of analyst communication and strengthen the credibility of internal governance. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the effect is most pronounced when the secretary possesses financial expertise, serves in environments characterized by opacity, intense investor attention, or weak institutional infrastructure, and works in high-tech industries where information complexity and the demands on the disclosure role are greatest.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨董事会秘书——中国上市公司法定信息披露负责人——的性别是否影响股价信息含量。基于高层梯队理论，我们提出女性董事会秘书作为更优的信息传递者，其独特的沟通风格和风险偏好降低了企业与资本市场之间的信息传递摩擦。利用2010年至2022年中国A股上市公司综合样本，我们发现女性董事会秘书所在公司的股价信息含量显著更高。为确立因果关系，我们采用交错双重差分设计，以处理不同公司间处理时点的异质性。动态处理效应证实了处理前趋势干净，且男性转女性过渡后第一年正向影响最为显著。反向的女性转男性过渡则无显著效应，支持因果解释。我们识别出两条作用渠道：女性秘书提升了分析师沟通质量，并增强了内部治理的可信度。异质性分析表明，当秘书具备财务专长、所处环境信息不透明、投资者关注度高或制度基础设施薄弱，以及在高科技行业——信息复杂性及信息披露角色要求最高——时，该效应最为显著。

title: “同气连枝”：华侨华人网络与企业出口
title_zh: “同气连枝”：华侨华人网络与企业出口

abstract: 作为中华民族共同体重要组成部分的海外华侨华人,其网络是联结中国与世界市场的重要桥梁。本文手工整理并构建了覆盖2362份涉侨族谱的“地区-姓氏-目的地”层面的华侨华人网络测度指标,经验检验了涉侨网络对微观企业出口的贸易创造效应。本文通过引入外生政策冲击,从动态视角考察了在贸易政策变化背景下涉侨网络对海外市场机遇的捕捉能力,并围绕宗族文化纽带,从信息匹配和宗族信任两个维度揭示了涉侨网络发挥贸易创造效应的作用路径。进一步分析表明,在国际交通和外资联系等正式渠道相对薄弱的情境下,华侨华人网络的“桥梁”作用更加显著。本研究为依托侨务资源畅通内外循环、稳定外贸发展提供了经验依据与路径参考。

title_zh: 贸易与污染范围：来自中国融入世界市场的证据

source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Although the environmental impact of trade has been a long-standing concern, there is still scant evidence on the channels through which international market access affects pollution. We exploit the unique episode of China’s world market integration in the early 2000s to provide direct empirical evidence on three such mechanisms, corresponding to each pollution scope: direct pollution at firms’ locations (scope-1), indirect pollution from energy generation (scope-2), and indirect pollution from the supply chain (scope-3). We combine granular satellite data on air pollution with detailed information on manufacturing firms and coal power plants, and leverage exogenous foreign demand shocks for identification. Three main findings emerge: exporting firms reduce local pollution; pollution levels around coal power plants rise due to regional export shocks; and upstream suppliers reduce pollution in the face of export demand shocks to downstream firms. Our findings point to China’s reliance on coal power plants to fuel its export-driven growth as one of the main drivers of the rise in pollution.
abstract_zh: 尽管贸易对环境的影响一直是长期关注的焦点，但关于国际市场准入如何影响污染的渠道证据仍然匮乏。我们利用21世纪初中国融入世界市场的独特时期，为三种机制提供了直接的经验证据，这些机制分别对应不同的污染范围：企业所在地的直接污染（范围1）、能源生产的间接污染（范围2）以及供应链的间接污染（范围3）。我们将高分辨率的卫星空气污染数据与制造业企业和燃煤电厂的详细信息相结合，并利用外生外国需求冲击进行识别。主要发现有三点：出口企业减少了当地污染；区域出口冲击导致燃煤电厂周边污染水平上升；面对下游企业的出口需求冲击，上游供应商减少了污染。我们的研究结果表明，中国依赖燃煤电厂来支撑其出口导向型增长，是污染加剧的主要驱动因素之一。

title: Digital transformation and climate transition risk management: Evidence from Chinese listed firms
title_zh: 数字化转型与气候转型风险管理：来自中国上市公司的证据
title_primary: 数字化转型与气候转型风险管理：来自中国上市公司的证据
title_secondary: Digital transformation and climate transition risk management: Evidence from Chinese listed firms
authors: Junru Guo, Jia He, Yuan Ren, Yixin Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a text-based measure of firms' climate transition risk management by constructing a dedicated dictionary and applying it to annual reports of Chinese listed firms over the period 2011–2021. Using this measure, we examine how corporate digital transformation relates to firms' management of climate transition risk. We find that digital transformation is positively associated with firms' engagement in climate transition risk management, with stronger effects for manufacturing and non-high-tech firms, and in particular for adopters of advanced digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing and big data. To address concerns of endogeneity, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences design and propensity score matching. Moreover, our evidence shows that digital transformation is associated with observable transition-related actions, including environmental investment and green patent output. While we do not find consistent evidence that digital transformation improves short-term profitability, stronger climate transition risk management is positively associated with firm value.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建专用词典并将其应用于2011至2021年间中国上市公司的年度报告，开发了一种基于文本的企业气候转型风险管理度量方法。利用这一度量，我们考察了企业数字化转型与气候转型风险管理之间的关系。研究发现，数字化转型与企业参与气候转型风险管理呈正相关，且这一效应在制造业及非高科技企业中更为显著，尤其是在采用人工智能、云计算和大数据等先进数字技术的企业中。为应对内生性问题，我们采用了交错双重差分设计和倾向得分匹配方法。此外，证据表明，数字化转型与可观察的转型相关行动相关联，包括环境投资和绿色专利产出。尽管我们未发现数字化转型能持续改善短期盈利能力的证据，但更强的气候转型风险管理与企业价值正相关。

abstract: 对于农村集体经济发展影响因素的研究，长期存在着社会建构与个体行为两种解释视角。前者强调结构的规范性和价值性对农村集体经济的塑造,后者则强调行为主体意识和行动的能动性对农村集体经济发展的重要作用。两种视角虽然都具有一定的解释力，但存在各自的理念局限，导致两种视角均存在认知偏差，难以揭示政府外部干预转化为农村集体经济发展内生动力的具体机制。为突破这一理论瓶颈，本文以贵州省岩博村为典型案例，建构“超越结...

title: A simple proof of the continuity of expected payoffs
title_zh: 期望收益连续性的一个简单证明
title_primary: 期望收益连续性的一个简单证明
title_secondary: A simple proof of the continuity of expected payoffs
authors: Christian Ewerhart
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In n -person games with compact strategy spaces and continuous payoff functions, the expected payoff functions of the mixed extension are continuous with respect to the product of the weak topologies. We provide an elementary proof of this fact. The analysis reveals that the Hausdorff separation axiom, commonly imposed on the topology of players’ strategy spaces, is not needed. We also show that the definition of expected payoffs as an iterated integral does not depend on the ordering of the players.
abstract_zh: 在具有紧策略空间和连续支付函数的n人博弈中，混合扩展的期望支付函数关于弱拓扑的乘积是连续的。我们给出了这一事实的初等证明。分析表明，通常施加于参与者策略空间拓扑的豪斯多夫分离公理并非必要。我们还证明了将期望支付定义为迭代积分的结果不依赖于参与者的顺序。

title: A dynamic model of capital investment with uncertain demand and Bayesian learning
title_zh: 需求不确定与贝叶斯学习下的资本投资动态模型
title_primary: 需求不确定与贝叶斯学习下的资本投资动态模型
title_secondary: A dynamic model of capital investment with uncertain demand and Bayesian learning
authors: Laura Delaney
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper employs a sequential learning framework to extend the static industrial organisation literature regarding optimal capacity choice and timing for incumbents and potential entrants to a dynamic environment with heterogeneous products in which uncertainty over future demand changes over time. The incumbent is uncertain about the quality of the entrant’s product and receives imperfect information signals at random points in time. Based on these signals, the incumbent updates his belief about the entrant’s product in a Bayesian fashion. Once adequately convinced about its true quality, he stops learning and makes a capacity choice according to his conviction. Existing models on capacity choice and timing in an incumbent-entrant context have not accounted for incomplete information and sequential learning in their analyses. As such, there are several novel implications that arise from the modeling framework, as well as new rationales for incumbent inertia and what this suggests in terms of over- and under-investment in capacity relative to the welfare-maximising socially optimal level.
abstract_zh: 本文采用序贯学习框架，将关于在位者与潜在进入者最优产能选择及时机的静态产业组织文献，扩展至一个产品具有异质性且未来需求不确定性随时间变化的动态环境中。在位者对于进入者产品的质量存在不确定性，并在随机时间点接收到不完美的信息信号。基于这些信号，在位者以贝叶斯方式更新其对进入者产品的信念。一旦充分确信其真实质量，他便停止学习，并根据其信念做出产能选择。现有关于在位者-进入者情境下产能选择与时机选择的模型，在分析中未考虑不完全信息与序贯学习。因此，该建模框架产生了若干新颖的推论，并为在位者惰性提供了新的解释，同时揭示了相对于福利最大化的社会最优水平，产能过度投资与投资不足的潜在原因。

title: Biofuel Growth: The Unintended Effects of the Ethanol Boom on Farmland Values
title_zh: 生物燃料增长：乙醇热潮对农田价值的非预期影响
title_primary: 生物燃料增长：乙醇热潮对农田价值的非预期影响
title_secondary: Biofuel Growth: The Unintended Effects of the Ethanol Boom on Farmland Values
authors: Hoanh Le, Oscar Galvez‐Soriano
official: 官方在线 2026-04-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper provides the first causal estimates of the impact of the U.S. ethanol boom on farmland values in the Midwest. Using county‐level data from the Census of Agriculture (1997–2022) and a difference‐in‐differences strategy that exploits variation in soil productivity, we find that farmland values in high corn‐suitability counties increased by $1147 per acre after 2005, equivalent to a 44% gain relative to pre‐ethanol boom levels. The effects are even larger in the most productive counties, where land values more than doubled. We also identify two reinforcing mechanisms: a short‐run response to higher corn prices and a longer‐run increase in farmland demand. These findings highlight how large‐scale energy policies can reshape rural land markets in ways that extend well beyond their intended objectives. JEL Classifications: Q11, Q24, Q28
abstract_zh: 本文首次对美国乙醇繁荣对中西部农田价值的影响提供了因果估计。利用农业普查（1997—2022年）的县级数据，并采用基于土壤生产力差异的双重差分策略，我们发现，在2005年之后，高玉米适宜性县的农田价值每英亩增加了1147美元，相当于相对于乙醇繁荣前水平44%的涨幅。在生产力最高的县，效应更为显著，土地价值增长超过一倍。我们还识别出两种强化机制：对玉米价格上涨的短期反应，以及农田需求的长期增长。这些发现凸显了大规模能源政策如何以远超其预期目标的方式重塑农村土地市场。JEL分类号：Q11, Q24, Q28

title: How cold is too cold? A theoretical analysis of the optimal trigger for index insurance for frost damage to crops
title_zh: 多冷才算太冷？作物霜冻损害指数保险最优触发条件的理论分析
title_primary: 多冷才算太冷？作物霜冻损害指数保险最优触发条件的理论分析
title_secondary: How cold is too cold? A theoretical analysis of the optimal trigger for index insurance for frost damage to crops
authors: Amogh Prakasha Kumar, Laura Meriluoto, Richard Watt
official: 官方在线 2026-03-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Crop insurance is undoubtedly an extremely valuable element in protecting agricultural businesses, but in many cases standard indemnity‐based products have had very low uptake due to high transaction costs elevating premiums to unaffordable levels. Index insurance options in which coverage is written on a publicly observable “trigger” (involving much lower transaction costs) have begun to fill the void. In almost all of the previous economics literature on index insurance, the only variable that the insurance demander is permitted to choose is the payment to be received should the index trigger value be verified. However, it is clear that the trigger value itself is an integral element in the contract, and it is an element about which the insurance demander has clear preferences. In this article, we analyze the optimal demand for index insurance under the assumption that the demander can choose both the payment to be received if the index trigger is satisfied and the trigger value itself. We find that there is always an interior solution to this problem. We also consider the market equilibria that emerge under a variety of settings in regard to the position of the insurer. The article is cast within the scope of insurance for frost damage to a crop, but all of the results are directly applicable to any peril for which a publicly observable signal exists. The article shows that allowing the demander to choose both indemnity and trigger value should increase uptake of index insurance products.
abstract_zh: 摘要 农作物保险无疑是保护农业经营中极具价值的要素，但在许多情况下，基于标准赔偿的保险产品因高交易成本导致保费升至难以负担的水平，其参保率一直很低。以公开可观察的“触发值”为基础（涉及较低交易成本）的指数保险选项已开始填补这一空白。在以往几乎所有关于指数保险的经济学文献中，保险需求方唯一被允许选择的变量是当指数触发值得到验证时应获得的赔付金额。然而，显然触发值本身是合同的一个组成部分，且保险需求方对此具有明确的偏好。本文在假设需求方既能选择指数触发条件满足时应获得的赔付金额，又能选择触发值本身的情况下，分析了指数保险的最优需求。我们发现该问题始终存在内部解。我们还考虑了在保险公司所处位置的各种设定下出现的市场均衡。本文以农作物霜冻损害保险为背景展开，但所有结果直接适用于任何存在公开可观察信号的灾害类型。研究表明，允许需求方同时选择赔付金额和触发值应能提高指数保险产品的参保率。

title: A New Estimator for Conditional Expectile-Based Value-at-Risk of a Linear Predictive Regression
title_zh: 线性预测回归中基于条件期望分位数VaR的新估计量
title_primary: 线性预测回归中基于条件期望分位数VaR的新估计量
title_secondary: A New Estimator for Conditional Expectile-Based Value-at-Risk of a Linear Predictive Regression
authors: Feipeng Zhang, Yuhan Ma, Heng Peng
official: 官方在线 2026-02-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Since it is the only elicitable law-invariant coherent risk measure, the expectile-based value-at-risk (EVaR) is a recently recommended risk measure in financial risk management. This paper considers the large sample statistical inference problem of conditional EVaR under a linear predictive regression model. Based on the least-squares residuals, we propose a novel least-squares residual estimator for the conditional EVaR of a linear predictive regression. The asymptotic properties of the proposed estimator are investigated in the context of dependence. We illustrate that the proposed estimator is computationally efficient and has desirable finite sample performance through numerical studies and an empirical application to risk assessment.

title: Overseas students, ideology, and the fall of dynastic China
title_zh: 海外留学生、意识形态与中华帝制的崩溃
title_primary: 海外留学生、意识形态与中华帝制的崩溃
title_secondary: Overseas students, ideology, and the fall of dynastic China
authors: James Kai-sing Kung, Alina Wang
official: 官方在线 2025-07-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the catalysis of an epochal institutional change by the contributions of a foreign-educated elite, effectively ending dynastic China. We show how the Qing government’s attempt to build a modern nation-state by sending the country’s best talent to study in Japan inadvertently heightened the students’ nationalist desire for social and political changes, culminating in the fall of the Qing dynasty. Specifically, each additional overseas student in a county led to significantly greater participation in political parties by the people of that county (41.5%), greater representation of its elite in the provincial assembly (11.4%), and a greater likelihood of that county declaring independence (11.5%) during the 1911 Revolution. To identify causality, we leverage the influence of the network of Zhang Zhidong – the father of overseas study – on the spatial variation of overseas students from each county. To ensure that the networks thus formed are plausibly exogenous, we exploit pre-existing connections – specifically those that Zhang formed with local officials before their randomized (re-)appointment to a (different) county – and the instrumented results hold. Last, we show that schools and newspapers were the primary channels through which the people were mobilized.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了海外留学精英的贡献如何催化了一场划时代的制度变革，并最终终结了帝制中国。研究表明，清政府试图通过派遣国内顶尖人才赴日留学来构建现代民族国家，却无意中强化了学生的民族主义诉求，推动社会与政治变革，最终导致清朝覆灭。具体而言，每增加一名海外留学生，该县民众参与政党的比例显著提升41.5%，精英在省议会中的代表比例增加11.4%，且在1911年辛亥革命期间该县宣布独立的可能性提高11.5%。为识别因果关系，我们利用张之洞（海外留学之父）的人际网络对各县留学生空间分布的影响。为确保由此形成的网络具有外生性，我们借助张之洞与地方官员在随机（重新）任命至（不同）县之前已存在的联系，工具变量结果保持稳健。最后，研究表明学校和报纸是动员民众的主要渠道。
